text:
Predicates:
Cost(x, y) ::: x costs y.
Cheaper(x, y) ::: x is cheaper than y.
ProvidesFinancialAid(x, y) ::: x provides financial aid to y.
ProveHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
LivingInSingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
HasFewResources(x) ::: x has few resources available.
LivesIn(x, y) ::: x lives in y.
ApplyingToTake(x) ::: x is applying to take the test.
Premises:
Cost( GRE, 205 ) ∧ Cheaper(205, 300) ::: It costs $205 to take the GRE, which is cheaper than $300.
∀x (ProveHardship(x) → (LivingInSingleParentFamily(x) ∨ HasFewResources(x))) ::: Those proving hardship can be living in single-parent families or having few resources.
LivingInSingleParentFamily(Tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
HasFewResources(Tom) ::: Tom has few resources available.
ApplyingToTake(Tom) ::: Tom is applying to take the GRE.
